notes.title: Update 1.37: Final Boss Mechanic Change, QoL, Bugs
notes.notes:
Update 1.37: Final Boss Mechanic Change, QoL, Bugs

 Balancing: Final boss 1 mechanic drastically changed, now has phase-dependent invincibility instead of damage reflect
 Balancing: Final boss 2 HP reduced by about 10%
 Balancing: Pinball side job 2 defense slightly easier with less enemies
 QoL: Job-giving NPCs now have exactly positioned markers on the map while job is ready or done
 QoL: Active job markers on the map now have a circular animation to clarify that they only mark the room but do not show the exact position
 QoL: Therematron shield direction improved, with gamepad keeps facing the last firing direction for a couple of seconds, with mouse and keyboard always faces mouse cursor
 QoL: Barriers in Pinball racing room are now open while the job is not active, though there is nothing of interest in that room
 Bugfix: Removed needless and faulty barrier in Computer Space Bar in front of the teleporter leading to the last port station
 Bugfix: Fixed erroneous triggering of a cutscene when entering Top Level Management in Tek Tek Inc
 Bugfix: Chiptune module no longer has an initial firing delay when switching to it during gameplay
 Text: Computer side job 3 dialog text gives a hint to the riddle number

notes.title: Update 1.36: Balancing, QoL, Bugs
notes.notes:
Update 1.36: Balancing, QoL, Bugs
Includes the same changes from 1.35. Correction for missing to mention the balancing change.

 Balancing: Final Boss HP reduced by 30% and attack delays reduced a little
 QoL: Job Menu now displays the NPC name in yellow for main jobs and in blue for optional side jobs
 Bugfix: Level fix in SynthWorld where a barrier could be bypassed
 Text: Added dialogs for clarification when approaching the first barriers in Synthetia before finishing the first job
 Text: Text corrections and minor clarifications
